That one is outside what I can help with. Dosing or cycling HGH is drug territory, and I don't give amounts, schedules or protocols for it. If you're considering it, talk to a doctor who can look at your bloodwork and your situation, since the risks are real and individual.

What I can do is help you chase the same goal through training. If it's size or strength you're after, tell me how many days you can train and what you want to move, and I'll set up a block for you.
